events.title: Adam
events.summary: Created and placed in the Garden; taught the names; descends to the earth as its first khalifah.

steps.title: Taught the names
steps.summary: Allah creates Adam, tells the angels a khalifah is coming, and teaches Adam the names of all things.

steps.title: Iblis refuses to bow
steps.summary: The angels are commanded to prostrate to Adam; all obey except Iblis, who refuses out of pride.

steps.title: The forbidden tree
steps.summary: Adam and his wife are told to enjoy the Garden but avoid one tree; Shaytan whispers to them until they eat from it.

steps.title: Repentance and descent
steps.summary: Adam receives words of repentance from his Lord and is forgiven, then he and his wife are sent down to the earth.

events.title: Nuh
events.summary: Calls his people for 950 years; the flood; the ark comes to rest on al-Judi.

steps.title: Calls his people
steps.summary: Nuh calls his people night and day, openly and secretly, to worship Allah alone, but most refuse.

steps.title: Builds the ark
steps.summary: Commanded to build a ship under Allah's watch, he is mocked by his people as he works.

steps.title: The flood and his son
steps.summary: The flood breaks out and Nuh boards the ark with believers and pairs of animals; his own son refuses to come aboard and drowns.

steps.title: The ark rests on Judi
steps.summary: The waters recede and the ark comes to rest on Mount Judi, ending the flood.

events.title: Hud
events.summary: Sent to 'Ad at the sand dunes; they are destroyed by a furious wind.

steps.title: Sent to 'Ad
steps.when: To the people of the dunes
steps.summary: Hud is sent to his people 'Ad and calls them to worship Allah alone.

steps.title: 'Ad refuse him
steps.summary: His people mock him and refuse to leave the gods of their forefathers.

steps.title: The cloud and the wind
steps.summary: They see what looks like a rain cloud approaching, but it is a violent wind carrying painful punishment.

steps.title: 'Ad destroyed
steps.summary: The wind rages over them for seven nights and eight days, leaving them fallen like hollow palm trunks.

events.title: Salih
events.summary: Sent to Thamud, who carved homes from mountains; they kill the she-camel.

steps.title: Sent to Thamud
steps.when: To the people of the rock
steps.summary: Salih is sent to Thamud and calls them to worship Allah alone.

steps.title: The she-camel as a sign
steps.summary: Allah sends a she-camel as a sign; Salih tells his people to let her drink and graze and not to harm her.

steps.title: The she-camel hamstrung
steps.summary: The most wretched of them hamstrings the she-camel, defying the warning he gave them.

steps.title: Thamud destroyed
steps.summary: A mighty shriek seizes them and they are found fallen dead in their homes.

events.title: Ibrahim
events.summary: Breaks the idols, is saved from the fire, and raises the foundations of the Ka'bah with Isma'il.

steps.title: Argues with his father
steps.summary: Ibrahim asks his father why he worships idols that neither hear nor see, and gently parts from him.

steps.title: Breaks the idols
steps.summary: Ibrahim smashes his people's idols to pieces, leaving only the largest one.

steps.title: Thrown into the Fire
steps.summary: His people build a fire and cast him into it, but Allah commands the fire to be cool and safe for him.

steps.title: Commanded to sacrifice his son
steps.when: When his son could work beside him
steps.summary: Ibrahim sees in a dream that he must sacrifice his son; both submit, and Allah ransoms the boy with a sacrifice.

steps.title: Builds the Ka'bah
steps.summary: Ibrahim and Isma'il raise the foundations of the House and pray for it to be accepted.

events.title: Lut
events.summary: Angels come to him as guests; he leaves by night with his family before his town is overturned.

steps.title: Warns his people
steps.summary: Lut warns his people against an immorality no people before them had committed.

steps.title: Angels as guests
steps.summary: Angels visit Lut in human form; his people rush toward his house, and he is distressed for his guests.

steps.title: Leaves by night
steps.summary: The angels tell Lut to leave with his family in the night and not look back; his wife is left behind to be struck.

steps.title: The town overturned
steps.summary: When the command comes, the town is turned upside down and pelted with stones of baked clay.

events.title: Yusuf
events.summary: Thrown in the well, sold in Egypt, imprisoned, then placed over the storehouses of the land.

steps.title: The dream
steps.summary: Yusuf tells his father of a dream of eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing to him; his father warns him to keep it from his brothers.

steps.title: Thrown in the well
steps.summary: His brothers throw him into a well and bring their father his shirt stained with false blood.

steps.title: Sold in Egypt
steps.summary: Travelers find him in the well and sell him for a low price to a noble of Egypt.

steps.title: The wife of al-Aziz
steps.summary: The nobleman's wife tries to seduce him; he flees and his shirt is torn from behind, proving his innocence.

steps.title: Prison and the king's dream
steps.summary: In prison he interprets two men's dreams, and is later called to interpret the king's dream of seven cows, which leads to his release.

steps.title: Reunited with his family
steps.summary: His shirt restores his father's sight, and his family comes to Egypt and bows before him, fulfilling his childhood dream.

events.title: Musa
events.summary: Confronts Pharaoh with Harun beside him, the sea is parted, and he receives the Tawrah.

steps.title: Infancy in the river
steps.summary: His mother casts him into the river to save him from Pharaoh; Pharaoh's household takes him in, and he is returned to his mother to nurse.

steps.title: Flight to Madyan
steps.summary: After killing a man by accident, Musa flees to Madyan, waters two women's flocks, and marries after working for their father.

steps.title: The burning bush
steps.summary: At a fire in the valley of Tuwa, Musa is called by name and commanded to worship Allah alone.

steps.title: Confronts Pharaoh
steps.summary: Musa and Harun deliver the message to Pharaoh; his magicians are outmatched and fall down believing.

steps.title: The sea parts
steps.summary: Musa strikes the sea with his staff and it parts; his people cross safely and Pharaoh's army is drowned.

steps.title: The golden calf
steps.when: While Musa was on the mount
steps.summary: While Musa receives the Tawrah, al-Samiri leads his people to worship a calf; Musa returns in anger and destroys it.

events.title: Dawud and Sulayman
events.summary: Dawud is given the Zabur and iron made soft; Sulayman is given the wind and the jinn.

steps.title: Defeats Jalut
steps.summary: Fighting under Talut against a much larger army, Dawud kills Jalut and Allah gives him kingship and wisdom.

steps.title: Given the Zabur and soft iron
steps.summary: Allah gives Dawud a Book and makes iron pliant in his hands, and the mountains and birds join his praise.

steps.title: The two disputants
steps.summary: Two men climb the wall to test his judgement with a dispute over ewes; Dawud realises it is a trial and turns to Allah in repentance.

steps.title: Sulayman commands wind and Jinn
steps.summary: Sulayman inherits prophethood and kingship, and the wind and the jinn are made to work under his command.

steps.title: The valley of ants
steps.summary: Passing a valley of ants, Sulayman hears one warn the others and smiles, grateful for the gift of understanding her speech.

steps.title: The queen of Sheba
steps.summary: The hoopoe brings news of a queen who rules a great kingdom; her throne is brought to Sulayman before she arrives, and she submits with him to Allah.

events.title: Yunus
events.summary: Leaves his people, is swallowed by the whale, and returns to a people who believed.

steps.title: Flees on a ship
steps.summary: Yunus leaves his people without Allah's permission and boards a ship; when it is overloaded, lots are drawn and he is cast into the sea.

steps.title: Swallowed by the fish
steps.summary: A great fish swallows him while he is blameworthy for leaving his people.

steps.title: Calls out in the darkness
steps.summary: In the darkness of the sea and the fish's belly, he calls out that there is no god but Allah and confesses his wrong.

steps.title: Cast onto the shore
steps.summary: Allah saves him and casts him, sick, onto an open shore, growing a gourd plant over him for shade.

steps.title: His people believe
steps.summary: He is sent back to over a hundred thousand people, and this time they believe and are spared the punishment.

events.title: Zakariyya and Yahya
events.summary: Zakariyya, old and childless, is given Yahya, who is given judgement while still a boy.

steps.title: Prays for a child
steps.summary: Old and his wife barren, Zakariyya privately asks his Lord for an heir to carry on his work.

steps.title: Good news of Yahya
steps.summary: Zakariyya is given the good news of a son named Yahya, a name given to no one before him.

steps.title: Sign of three days' silence
steps.summary: Zakariyya asks for a sign, and is told his sign is that he will not speak to people for three days though he is sound.

steps.title: Yahya given wisdom as a boy
steps.summary: Yahya is given judgement, affection and purity while still a boy, and is devoted to his parents.

events.title: Isa
events.summary: Born to Maryam without a father; not killed nor crucified, but raised up.

steps.title: The angel's announcement
steps.summary: An angel comes to Maryam in human form and announces a pure son, though no man has touched her.

steps.title: Birth under the palm tree
steps.summary: Maryam withdraws to give birth alone; a voice tells her not to grieve, and provides her water and fresh dates.

steps.title: The infant speaks
steps.summary: When her people accuse her, Maryam points to the baby; Isa speaks from the cradle, declaring himself a servant of Allah.

steps.title: Miracles by Allah's permission
steps.summary: As a messenger to the Children of Israel, Isa heals the blind and the leper and gives life to the dead, all by Allah's permission.

steps.title: Raised, not crucified
steps.when: At the end of his mission
steps.summary: His enemies plot to kill him, but they neither kill nor crucify him; Allah raises him to Himself.
